title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Specialty Pharmacy Program: Late Charge Waiver for Members Owing Specialty Balances
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: specialty balances and installment late charges

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, a further part of the late charge is waived when the member also owes Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy: a quarter of the original late charge when the balance due on the member's active specialty enrollment is 250.00 or more, a tenth of the original late charge when that balance is above zero but under 250.00, and nothing when nothing is owed there. Waived parts are shares of the original late charge, so they are added together and taken off that charge once.

The balance read is the balance due on the member's active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment.

### Waiver by specialty balance

| Balance due on the active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment | Share of the original late charge waived |
|---|---|
| 250.00 or more | a quarter (0.25) |
| above zero, under 250.00 | a tenth (0.1) |
| zero, or no active specialty enrollment | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases (original late charge of 10.00)

- Specialty balance 250.00: 2.50 waived. 249.99: 1.00 waived.
- Where a waived quarter of 10.00 stands alongside another waived half of 10.00, the two shares are added, three quarters, and 7.50 is taken off the original 10.00 once, leaving 2.50.
